title: HashMap defaults
prompt: A new HashMap() in Java 25 starts with which capacity and load factor?
explanation: The Java 25 HashMap documentation says the no-argument constructor uses capacity 16 and load factor 0.75. When entries exceed capacity times load factor, the table rehashes to about twice as many buckets.

misconceptions.explanation: Capacity is the bucket count; the load factor is the fraction that triggers resizing.
